data.message: I propose individual opt-ins to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal; I commit to 18. Each switch from 10 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). This is risky, not a proven long-run optimum; intentions aren't binding, and other catches need recalculation. All 24 others: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. You may choose 18 even if others choose 10. Fisher02/23, please help recruit.
